# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 20 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 20:1 — torah: "instruction" vs. "teaching" vs. "what You teach"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "instruction" | Standard rendering of torah in non-Pentateuchal context |
| LOGOS | "teaching" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "what You teach" | Dynamic periphrasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "instruction" -- torah as "instruction" is the project convention.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 20:5 — "fountain" vs. "font" vs. "fountain"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "fountain" | Standard English |
| LOGOS | "font" | Archaic/formal |
| PNEUMA | "fountain" | Matches EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "fountain" -- standard and clear.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 20:10 — hesed: "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "lovingkindness" vs. "faithful love"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "covenant-faithfulness" | Project convention |
| LOGOS | "lovingkindness" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "faithful love" | Modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "covenant-faithfulness" per project convention.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 20:13 — "engraved" vs. "inscribed" vs. "carved"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "engraved" | Literal: chaqaq = engrave permanently |
| LOGOS | "inscribed" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "carved" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "engraved" -- chaqaq implies permanence.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 20:16 — "contrite heart" vs. "humbled heart" vs. "broken, open heart"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "contrite heart" | Standard biblical (Ps 51:19) |
| LOGOS | "humbled heart" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "broken, open heart" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "contrite heart" -- the Psalm 51:19 allusion should be preserved.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 20:** 5
